text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — Partial routing to legacy (blue) cluster in eu-west-1. Elevated 5xxs for a subset of traffic. Auto-alerting oncall.
melody (oncall): seeing spikes in 502/504s ~ 06:12 UTC, looks correlated with the blue->green flip that started at 06:08.
melody (oncall): paging @raj and @carol — can you take a look?
pagerduty: Paging raj (sre) — high-priority.
raj (sre): on it. first pass: checking loadbalancer and DNS.
carol (infra): I'm pulling LB weight metrics — some hosts still have old backend ip ranges. Not full traffic but ~18% of requests hitting legacy group.
kevin (deploy): rollback of the canary was initiated automatically when canary health dipped, but full rollout continued due to a flag propagation race. Investigating flag propagation.
melody (oncall): customer-impact: CS reporting degraded responses for EU customers (slow page loads, form submits failing). CS: ~10 orgs flagged so far.
customer-success: confirm, multiple EU customers seeing intermittent failures since 06:10 UTC. Some errors bubble into our SaaS integrators.
raj (sre): checking DNS TTL and edge caching. Run dig against our service FQDN:
```
$ dig +short svc.eu.redwood.example
10.4.5.11
10.4.5.12
52.23.88.101  ; edge A
52.23.88.102  ; edge B
```
raj (sre): noticed our edge pool IPs resolve differently from different resolvers — looks like partial DNS propagation + low TTL but some resolvers served stale answer.
carol (infra): also seeing the LB config: weightflip job didn't fully propagate to edge-proxies in eu-west-1 due to a parallel deploy on the proxy host group. Some proxies still routing 100% to blue backend.
kevin (deploy): ack — feature flag 'geo-blueflip' was toggled but the flag service TTL was 0, and a recent redeploy cleared local caches unevenly. Working on a kill-switch to force green-only routing.
melody (oncall): mitigation priority: 1) prevent further customer impact (kill-switch), 2) re-align DNS/LB state, 3) full rollback if needed.
natalie (eng): prepared a quick patch to the flag gate that forces route=green for eu regions. Ready to apply if SRE approves.
raj (sre): please hold on patch — before forcing, try graceful weight adjustment to avoid mass disconnects. Issuing LB command now:
```
# set weight to green cluster 100 in eu-west
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN' https://lb.api.internal/v1/weights -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","green":100}'
```
raj (sre): LB API returned 202; pushing config to proxies. Watching metrics.
carol (infra): pushing a proxy restart to the 2 hosts that were blocked by the parallel deploy, should pick up new LB weights. Doing rolling restart with 30s drain.
melody (oncall): CS: update customers that we're actively mitigating, ETA ~10-15m for containment.
customer-success: will send an interim note. Please confirm when safe to escalate to customers with RFO.
raj (sre): metric check — 502 rate dropped from 18% to 3% across eu-west in the last 4m. Error tail reduced. Edge logs show reduced 502s from legacy backends.
kevin (deploy): feature flag service shows inconsistent cache states — will add a read-after-write guard and re-deploy flag service. Rolling back canary toggles to previous stable state as belt-and-suspenders.
melody (oncall): who is taking lead on postmortem and customer impact tally? Suggest @natalie for timeline, @kevin for deploy root cause, @raj for infra actions.
natalie (eng): I will collect timelines and reproduce steps. Will pull request a short eval test for flag propagation.
incident-bot: NOTE — oncall handoff in 40 minutes. @melody if you want to handoff to @raj, acknowledge here.
melody (oncall): handing off to @raj for the rest of the mitigation window. I'm stepping out for a quick meeting but will remain reachable.
raj (sre): taking over primary. Contact if anything regresses.
carol (infra): completing proxy restarts — all proxies now report green route 100. Confirmed via /health endpoints and proxy logs:
```
[2026-03-15T06:20:01Z] proxy-3 eu-west-1 applied weights {green:100, blue:0}
[2026-03-15T06:20:05Z] proxy-4 eu-west-1 applied weights {green:100, blue:0}
```
raj (sre): running verification sweep — curl against service from multiple EU vantage points shows 200 responses, latency normal.
kevin (deploy): flag service redeploy completed with read-after-write guard. No evidence of feature flag corruption in traces.
melody (oncall): can we confirm cause hypothesis: parallel proxy deploy created a window where LB weights and flag cache were out of sync, causing some resolvers and proxies to route to legacy blue. Partial DNS propagation + short TTL amplified the mismatch.
carol (infra): yep. Also found a bug: our weightflip scheduler didn't check proxy drain status before marking rollout done. Filing an infra bug.
natalie (eng): collecting impacted customers: rough estimate 12 orgs with increased 5xx, 3 with brief SLA blips. Will finalize list in 30m.
raj (sre): mitigation complete. Will continue to monitor for 30m. If stable, we close incident and open postmortem.
melody (oncall): thanks team. Quick notes for postmortem: add pre-check for proxy deploy concurrency, tighten flag service cache invalidation, and add DNS resolver sampling to rollout checks.
customer-success: sending customer update: "Mitigation in place, traffic re-routed to stable cluster, monitoring for stability. We'll follow up with full postmortem." :thumbsup:
melody (oncall): closing handoff. I'll update the incident channel with final RFO when we have all timelines.
raj (sre): last check 06:36 UTC — error rate steady at baseline. Marking last_message_ts=2823457160 for thread.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated, follow-up postmortem required.
